_real_world.role: Short-range, high-off-boresight, lock-on-after-launch air-to-air missile carried by all CVW-8 fixed-wing fighter/attack types
_real_world.range_nmi: Classified; est WVR planning envelope <= ~18 nmi (est, csg-us-aim9x-navair)
_real_world.guidance_real: Imaging IR seeker, high off-boresight, thrust-vectoring airframe control; Block II adds a datalink enabling lock-on-after-launch and beyond-visual-range cueing from the launch aircraft
_real_world.mount_mapping: referenced by CVW-8 aircraft default_loadout as an air-to-air weapon; standard air-launched missile mechanism

mass_kg.note: 186 lb = 84.37 kg per CSG order-of-battle page's NAVAIR-sourced AIM-9X Block II row

max_flight_time_s.note: no public burn/flight-time figure; engineering estimate bounded loosely by the OOB page's estimated <=~18 nmi WVR planning envelope at the used 850 m/s speed proxy

flight_model.max_speed.note: classified; proxy copied unchanged from the repo AIM-9X template (weapons/air_to_air/aim_9x.json)

flight_model.max_g.note: proxy copied unchanged from the repo AIM-9X template; no public figure, though thrust-vectoring high-g maneuverability is a publicly known qualitative feature

flight_model.max_turn_rate.note: proxy copied unchanged from the repo AIM-9X template; no public figure

guidance.type.note: imaging IR seeker confirmed per NAVAIR (OOB page)

guidance.off_boresight_cap.note: high off-boresight capability confirmed qualitatively per NAVAIR; exact cap angle not public, 90.0 deg proxy copied unchanged from the repo AIM-9X template as a representative high-off-boresight value

guidance.active_seek_range.note: no public seeker acquisition range; engineering estimate typical of an imaging-IR short-range seeker, added beyond the repo AIM-9X template (which omits this field) since Block II's lock-on-after-launch datalink capability implies an engine-relevant seeker-range concept

guidance.pn_los_rate_source.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, not a sourced weapon characteristic

guidance.target_kinematics_estimator.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, same basis as pn_los_rate_source

guidance.capture_guidance_mode.note: disabled: Block II's lock-on-after-launch capability is not modeled as a distinct capture-guidance submode in this pass

guidance.target_tracker_alpha.note: standard alpha-beta-gamma tracker filter constant, engine convention shared across missile records, not weapon-specific

guidance.target_tracker_beta.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.target_tracker_gamma.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.nav_gain.note: proxy copied unchanged from the repo AIM-9X template; no public guidance-law constant

guidance.apn_target_accel_gain.note: proxy copied unchanged from the repo AIM-9X template

guidance.autopilot_tau_s.note: proxy copied unchanged from the repo AIM-9X template

guidance.max_accel_response_g_per_s.note: proxy copied unchanged from the repo AIM-9X template

warhead.type.note: annular blast-fragmentation warhead per NAVAIR; Frag is the nearest real engine-recognized warhead type

warhead.mass_kg.note: proxy copied unchanged from the repo AIM-9X template; no public warhead mass figure

warhead.lethal_radius.note: proxy copied unchanged from the repo AIM-9X template; no public figure

warhead.damage.note: engineering-estimate surrogate; no public damage-effectiveness figure

warhead.explosive_mass_kg.note: engineering-estimate HE/case split of warhead.mass_kg; no public split figure

warhead.case_mass_kg.note: engineering-estimate HE/case split, see explosive_mass_kg; case mass set relatively high consistent with an annular-fragmentation warhead design

warhead.projection_radius_fraction.note: engineering-estimate copied/scaled from the repo AIM-120C-7 template's projection-geometry pattern

warhead.projection_max_radius_m.note: engineering-estimate scaled from this warhead's smaller lethal_radius relative to the AIM-120C-7 template pattern

warhead.projection_max_projected_hitboxe.note: copied from the repo AIM-120C-7 template pattern

fuze.type.note: no public fuze family confirmation; laser_proximity copied unchanged from the repo AIM-9X template as the nearest real engine-recognized fuze family for a short-range IR missile's active optical fuze

fuze.trigger_radius_m.note: proxy copied unchanged from the repo AIM-9X template; no public standoff distance

fuze.delay_s.note: proxy copied unchanged from the repo AIM-9X template; no public fuze timing data

fuze.reliability.note: engineering-estimate marginally above the repo AIM-9X template's 0.92, reflecting the Block II's incremental maturity improvements per general public program reporting, not a quantified figure

modeling_notes: Functional mount via standard air-launched missile mechanism. Range and speed classified per NAVAIR (OOB page); repo AIM-9X template used as the same-family sourced anchor for unclassified-adjacent flight/guidance scaffold fields.
